dynamic_findings.reason: Fixed REVOKE ALL TABLE audit.records target. Non-owner ACL grantee OID0 maps to PUBLIC; all other pg_roles names pass pg_catalog.quote_ident before %s. Privilege removal only; exact grants/readback retained.

Fixed REVOKE ALL FUNCTION audit.refuse_change() target. Same PUBLIC/prequoted catalogue-role boundary from that function ACL. Explicit NULL-ACL PUBLIC revoke and exact non-owner ACL readback retained.
Fixed REVOKE ALL SCHEMA audit target. Same PUBLIC/prequoted catalogue-role boundary from that schema ACL. Restore/check exact declared schema/table rights, no function grant.
Fixed REVOKE ALL TABLE template. r.rel separately quote_ident-renders catalogue schema/relation; filter limits tables/views to records. r.who is PUBLIC for0 or quote_ident-rendered pg_roles name.

Fixed REVOKE ALL FUNCTION template. r.fn uses %I schema/function identifiers plus PostgreSQL pg_get_function_identity_arguments backend rendering, not raw argument/default/body text. r.who is PUBLIC or prequoted catalogue role; filter restricts records.
Fixed REVOKE ALL SCHEMA records target, with PUBLIC/prequoted catalogue grantee. Restrictive operation and exact restore/readback preserved.
Two single-quoted EXECUTE privilege labels in static allowed VALUES data, compared with ACL privilege_type; neither token invokes PL/pgSQL EXECUTE or supplies formatter SQL.
